He talks about lending, interest rates and deals activity on "Bloomberg The Close." Third-quarter results topped Wall Street estimates as consumers and businesses held steady. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: U.S. Stocks Tick Down as Bank Earnings Don’t Excite
items.summary: It was a sluggish day for U.S. stock movements, as early bank earnings failed to quash broader concerns about inflation and Fed rate hikes.

items.title: AI Fuels Game Streaming to $38 Billion as Consoles Fade, BI Says
items.summary: Games streamed over the internet will grow to a $38 billion market by 2035 and may eventually kill off the dedicated video-game console as a mass-market product, according to research from Bloomberg Intelligence.

items.title: Anthropic to disclose new revenue numbers as AI lab financials become central to tech trade

items.title: China's Robotic Hands Key to $5 Trillion AI Humanoid Development Race

items.title: Higher Rates Turbocharge Lending Income for Biggest US Banks
items.summary: Three of the biggest US banks set a fresh record in the third quarter for how much they earned from lending, with customers continuing to borrow even as interest rates increased. Norah Mulinda has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: BOE Hawk Pill Skeptical of Market Pricing Four UK Rate Hikes
items.summary: One of the Bank of England’s most hawkish officials cast doubt on market pricing that suggests the UK central bank will hike interest rates four times by next summer.

Judge orders OpenAI to turn over hiring records in Apple trade secrets case
